natural: not even chickens and dogs left

meaning.en: To wipe out everything, leaving no living thing.
meaning.zh: 连鸡和狗都不留下，形容杀戮或破坏极其彻底。

examples.zh: 匪徒洗劫村庄，几乎鸡犬不留。
examples.en: The bandits ransacked the village, leaving almost nothing alive.

examples.zh: 在小说里，反派扬言要杀得鸡犬不留。
examples.en: In the novel the villain threatened to leave not a living thing behind.

usage.en: Describes ruthless massacre; mostly historical or fiction. Not the same as 鸡犬不宁 (no peace, in turmoil).
usage.zh: 形容残酷的杀戮；多用于历史或小说。注意与“鸡犬不宁”（不得安宁）不同。

meaning.en: To judge someone's thoughts and mood from his face and manner.
meaning.zh: 观察人的脸色，揣摩其心意。

examples.zh: 好服务员要懂得鉴貌辨色，及时满足客人的需要。
examples.en: A good waiter knows how to read faces and meets guests' needs in time.

examples.zh: 他善于鉴貌辨色，所以总能顺着上司的心意办事。
examples.en: He is good at reading faces, so he always acts as his superiors wish.

usage.en: Close to 察言观色; may be neutral (tact) or negative (toadying) depending on context. Predicate.
usage.zh: 与“察言观色”相近；依语境可指机敏体贴，也可含奉承之意。作谓语。

meaning.en: The din of men shouting and horses neighing, as in battle or a busy caravan.
meaning.zh: 人叫喊，马嘶鸣，形容战场或热闹场面喧闹的情景。

equivalents: the din of men and horses
a clamour of voices and hooves

examples.zh: 战鼓一响，只听得人喊马嘶，杀声震天。
examples.en: As the war drums sounded there was nothing but the shouting of men and neighing of horses and cries of battle.

examples.zh: 驿站里人喊马嘶，十分忙碌。
examples.en: The post station was full of the shouts of men and the neighing of horses and very busy.

usage.en: Atmospheric phrase for noisy, chaotic scenes, mainly in battle or travel scenes of fiction. Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 渲染喧闹混乱场面的词语，多见于战争、行旅场景的小说。作谓语、定语。

natural: one and the same, no difference

meaning.en: Exactly the same; indistinguishable.
meaning.zh: 完全相同，没有区别。

examples.zh: 这两幅画一般无二，几乎看不出差别。
examples.en: The two paintings are identical; you can hardly see any difference.

examples.zh: 她的字迹和母亲的一般无二。
examples.en: Her handwriting is exactly like her mother's.

usage.en: Mostly in written, slightly old-fashioned use; very close to 一模一样 in meaning. Predicate.
usage.zh: 多用于书面，稍带旧味；意思与“一模一样”很近。作谓语。

meaning.en: To be full of doubts and unanswered questions.
meaning.zh: 心里有许多疑问，想不通。

examples.zh: 听完他的解释，我仍然满腹疑团。
examples.en: After hearing his explanation I was still full of doubts.

examples.zh: 他带着满腹疑团走进了那间屋子。
examples.en: He went into the room full of questions.

usage.en: A set phrase, often with 带着 or 心中. Close to 满腹狐疑, but neutral about whether the doubts are suspicious.
usage.zh: 固定词组，常与“带着”“心中”连用。与“满腹狐疑”相近，但不一定含猜忌。

meaning.en: Advice or remarks based on first-hand experience.
meaning.zh: 根据亲身经历得出的看法或建议。

equivalents: advice from someone who's been there

examples.zh: 这是我多年工作的经验之谈，供你参考。
examples.en: These words come from many years of experience and are offered for your reference.

examples.zh: 老师傅的经验之谈，让新人少走了不少弯路。
examples.en: The old craftsman's advice from experience saved newcomers from many detours.

usage.en: A common set phrase, usually as predicate ('这是…') or object of 听。 Positive; lets the speaker claim authority modestly.
usage.zh: 常见固定词组，多作谓语（“这是……”）或“听”的宾语。褒义；说话者借以谦虚地说明依据。

natural: no ground to stand an awl on

meaning.en: To be so poor as not to own even a tiny scrap of land.
meaning.zh: 穷得连插锥子的一点地方也没有，形容极端贫穷。

examples.zh: 他年轻时贫无立锥，靠打零工度日。
examples.en: In his youth he did not own an inch of land and lived on odd jobs.

examples.zh: 战乱使许多人贫无立锥，流离失所。
examples.en: The war left many people destitute and homeless.

usage.en: Literary; often used of landless peasants. Related to the saying 无立锥之地. Predicate.
usage.zh: 书面语；常指无地农民。与“无立锥之地”相关。作谓语。

meaning.en: To meet unexpectedly and by happy chance.
meaning.zh: 偶然相遇，多指意外的美好相遇。

examples.zh: 两位老同学在异国邂逅相逢，格外惊喜。
examples.en: The two old classmates met by chance in a foreign country and were delighted.

examples.zh: 在旅途中邂逅相逢的朋友，成了他一生的知己。
examples.en: The friend he met by chance on a journey became his lifelong confidant.

story.en: The Odes song 'Wild Grass' describes a happy chance meeting: 'We meet by chance, just as I had wished' (邂逅相遇，适我愿兮).
story.zh: 《诗经·郑风·野有蔓草》：“邂逅相遇，适我愿兮。”

usage.en: Often warm and romantic. 邂逅 (xiè hòu) alone is the more common modern word; the four-character form is literary.
usage.zh: 常带温暖或浪漫色彩。现代更常用“邂逅”一词；四字形式偏书面。

natural: do not look at what is improper

meaning.en: Do not look at what is against propriety; maintain moral discipline.
meaning.zh: 不合礼的不要看，要约束自己的言行。

equivalents: guard your eyes against what is improper

examples.zh: “非礼勿视，非礼勿听”教导我们要自我约束。
examples.en: 'Look not at what is improper, listen not to what is improper' teaches us self-discipline.

examples.zh: 面对网络上的不良信息，要做到非礼勿视。
examples.en: In the face of harmful online content, we should refuse to look at what is improper.

story.en: Yan Yuan asked about humaneness; Confucius said: 'Do not look at what is contrary to ritual, do not listen to it, do not speak it, do not do it' (非礼勿视，非礼勿听，非礼勿言，非礼勿动).
story.zh: 颜渊问仁，孔子说：“非礼勿视，非礼勿听，非礼勿言，非礼勿动。”

usage.en: A Confucian moral rule, always with its companions 非礼勿听、非礼勿言、非礼勿动. Used in moral advice; sometimes ironic.
usage.zh: 儒家道德准则，常与“非礼勿听、非礼勿言、非礼勿动”并称。用于道德劝诫；有时带戏谑。

natural: be loyal and think of the state

meaning.en: To be public-spirited and loyal and put the nation's interests first.
meaning.zh: 一心为公，忠诚尽责，以国家利益为重。

examples.zh: 他公忠体国，为朝廷鞠躬尽瘁。
examples.en: He was loyal and public-spirited, and gave himself wholly to the court.

examples.zh: 公忠体国的官员，往往不计较个人得失。
examples.en: Officials who put the state first are seldom concerned with personal gain.

usage.en: A strong, formal word of praise for officials. Often attributive. Used for historical figures.
usage.zh: 对官员的高度赞语，正式。常作定语。多用于历史人物。

meaning.en: A naive opinion typical of a bookish person with no practical experience.
meaning.zh: 读书人不切实际、过于理想化的看法。

examples.zh: 你的方案太理想化，不过是书生之见。
examples.en: Your plan is too idealistic; it is just a bookworm's view.

examples.zh: 他谦虚地说这只是书生之见，请大家指正。
examples.en: He modestly said it was only a scholar's opinion and asked for corrections.

usage.en: Often used humbly of one's own views (书生之见，仅供参考) or critically of others'. Noun phrase.
usage.zh: 常用来谦称自己的看法（“书生之见，仅供参考”），或批评别人不切实际。名词性。

meaning.en: To shout furiously, like roaring thunder.
meaning.zh: 大声怒吼，声音像雷鸣一样。

examples.zh: 老板气得咆哮如雷，整个办公室都听到了。
examples.en: The boss was so angry he bellowed, and the whole office heard.

examples.zh: 洪水咆哮如雷，卷走了桥梁。
examples.en: The flood roared like thunder and swept the bridge away.

usage.en: Describes angry people or loud nature, such as floods and beasts. Predicate or attributive. Compare 暴跳如雷, which stresses jumping about in fury.
usage.zh: 形容人发怒或洪水、猛兽等发出巨响。作谓语、定语。可比较“暴跳如雷”，后者强调暴怒跳脚。

meaning.en: A notice issued to reassure the public; today also a statement meant to calm people's fears.
meaning.zh: 安定民心的布告；今也指为消除疑虑而发布的声明。

equivalents: a notice to calm everyone down

examples.zh: 城破之后，新官府立刻贴出安民告示。
examples.en: After the city fell, the new authorities at once posted a notice to reassure the people.

examples.zh: 公司裁员风声四起，管理层必须发个安民告示。
examples.en: With layoff rumours spreading, management has to issue a statement to calm everyone.

usage.en: Historical term, now often used figuratively for a calming announcement; neutral or slightly ironic. Noun phrase.
usage.zh: 历史名词，今多比喻消除疑虑的公告；中性或略带讽刺。名词性。

meaning.en: The rules laid down by ancestors, treated as unchangeable.
meaning.zh: 祖先留下的规矩，被视为不可更改的传统。

equivalents: the way it has always been done

examples.zh: 他搬出祖宗家法，坚决反对改变家族企业的经营方式。
examples.en: He cited the ancestral rules and firmly opposed any change in how the family firm was run.

examples.zh: 祖宗家法不能当作拒绝改革的借口。
examples.en: Ancestral rules should not be an excuse for refusing reform.

usage.en: Often critical when cited to block change; can also refer neutrally to a family's real rules. Noun phrase.
usage.zh: 常用于批评以祖制为由阻碍变革；也可中性指家族的规矩。名词性。

natural: seek life in the midst of death

meaning.en: To look for a way out of a desperate situation.
meaning.zh: 在几乎没有希望的境地中寻找生路。

equivalents: fight for survival against the odds
seek a way out of a hopeless situation

examples.zh: 企业濒临破产，只能死中求活，转型做电商。
examples.en: The firm was close to bankruptcy and had to try a last-ditch change to e-commerce.

examples.zh: 战士们被围困在山上，决定死中求活，突围而出。
examples.en: Surrounded on the mountain, the soldiers decided to break out and seek survival against the odds.

usage.en: Describes bold action in extreme situations; compare 置之死地而后生. Predicate.
usage.zh: 形容危急时刻的大胆行动；可比较“置之死地而后生”。作谓语。

meaning.en: To betray one's master or superiors for personal gain.
meaning.zh: 出卖主人或上级，换取个人的荣华富贵。

equivalents: sell out one's boss for personal gain

examples.zh: 他为了升职，竟然卖主求荣，把老板的秘密告诉了对手。
examples.en: To get promoted he sold out his boss and told the rival his secrets.

examples.zh: 历史上卖主求荣的人，往往没有好下场。
examples.en: Those in history who betrayed their lords for gain usually came to a bad end.

usage.en: Strongly condemnatory; compare 卖国求荣 (sell out the country). Predicate or attributive.
usage.zh: 强烈谴责；可比较“卖国求荣”（出卖国家）。作谓语、定语。

meaning.en: To be trapped with no way forward or back.
meaning.zh: 前进后退都没有路，形容处境极其困难。

equivalents: stuck between a rock and a hard place

examples.zh: 前有大河，后有追兵，他们进退无路。
examples.en: With a river ahead and pursuers behind, they had no way forward or back.

examples.zh: 资金链断裂后，公司进退无路。
examples.en: After the funding chain broke, the company was cornered.

usage.en: Close to 进退两难 and 走投无路; stresses a physically or situationally blocked path. Predicate.
usage.zh: 与“进退两难”“走投无路”相近；强调路被堵死。作谓语。

meaning.en: In a dreamy, absent-minded way, without much purpose; also time passing unnoticed.
meaning.zh: 形容精神恍惚，无所用心，或日子在不知不觉中过去。

examples.zh: 他悠悠忽忽地过了大半辈子，一事无成。
examples.en: He drifted through most of his life and achieved nothing.

examples.zh: 一个下午悠悠忽忽地就过去了。
examples.en: The afternoon drifted by in a haze.

usage.en: Often adverbial (悠悠忽忽地), with a hint of mild criticism of aimlessness. Colloquial-literary.
usage.zh: 常作状语（悠悠忽忽地），略含对无所事事的批评。口语兼书面。

meaning.en: A peaceful, well-ordered society.
meaning.zh: 政治清明、社会安定太平的世道。

equivalents: an age of peace and justice

examples.zh: 清平世界，朗朗乾坤，岂容你胡作非为！
examples.en: In a peaceful and orderly world, how can you be allowed to do wrong!

examples.zh: 人们都盼望过上清平世界的生活。
examples.en: People all hoped to live in a peaceful and orderly society.

usage.en: A set phrase often seen in the line 清平世界，朗朗乾坤 (quoted in opera and novels, said indignantly when injustice is found). Formal or dramatic.
usage.zh: 常见于“清平世界，朗朗乾坤”（戏曲、小说中遇不平事时的义愤之语）。正式或带戏剧色彩。

meaning.en: A person who does great things without recognition or fame.
meaning.zh: 做出重要贡献却不为人知的人。

examples.zh: 清洁工是城市的无名英雄。
examples.en: Cleaners are the unsung heroes of the city.

examples.zh: 这次救灾中，许多无名英雄默默付出。
examples.en: In this relief effort many unsung heroes quietly gave their all.

usage.en: A warm modern phrase; the English 'unsung hero' is a close match. Used in news and speeches. Noun phrase.
usage.zh: 带温情的现代词组，英语 unsung hero 相当贴切。用于新闻、演讲。名词性。

meaning.en: To run a business with very little capital.
meaning.zh: 资本少、规模小的经营方式。

equivalents: run a small business on a shoestring

examples.zh: 他开了家小店，小本经营，赚的是辛苦钱。
examples.en: He runs a little shop on a shoestring and earns it the hard way.

examples.zh: 小本经营经不起折腾，一次亏损就可能倒闭。
examples.en: A small business cannot take much upheaval; one loss could close it.

usage.en: A descriptive set phrase, often in shop signs (‘小本经营，概不赊账’ = 'small business, no credit'). Neutral to sympathetic.
usage.zh: 描述性固定词组，常见于店铺告示（“小本经营，概不赊账”）。中性偏同情。

natural: as close as flesh and blood

meaning.en: Feelings as close as those between blood relatives.
meaning.zh: 感情像亲人一样深厚。

examples.zh: 两家人多年来情同骨肉，相互扶持。
examples.en: The two families have been as close as relatives for many years and supported each other.

examples.zh: 她和养母情同骨肉，胜过亲生母女。
examples.en: She and her adoptive mother are as close as kin, closer than many real mothers and daughters.

usage.en: A warm phrase for friends or neighbours; compare 情同手足 (like siblings). Predicate.
usage.zh: 形容朋友、邻居间亲密的词语；可比较“情同手足”。作谓语。

natural: hook out the deep and reach the far

meaning.en: To dig into profound principles and understand distant, hidden matters.
meaning.zh: 探求深奥的道理，达到深远的境地。

equivalents: probe the depths and reach far

examples.zh: 治学要钩深致远，而不是浅尝辄止。
examples.en: To study properly one must delve deep and reach far rather than dabble.

examples.zh: 他的研究钩深致远，为后人开辟了新天地。
examples.en: His research delves into the profound and opened a new field for later scholars.

story.en: 'To search the abstruse and seek the hidden, to hook out the deep and reach the far, thus to settle the good and bad of the world' (探赜索隐，钩深致远，以定天下之吉凶).
story.zh: “探赜索隐，钩深致远，以定天下之吉凶，成天下之亹亹者，莫大乎蓍龟。”

usage.en: A scholarly expression praising depth of inquiry; formal and literary. Predicate.
usage.zh: 称赞探究深入的学术用语；正式、书面。作谓语。
